test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The average marks of students of section A and section B of class XI in a school have been presented in the given bar graph. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716e1b98cc1a3a5c5c52fad4727063bc594eca9719b7fc885d4d85fe3bca252e.png] 

In how many subjects have the students of section A shown better result?
solution: In four subjects(i.e. English, Maths, Science and Social science), the students of section A show better result.
